answer: Random peer audit guards the harbor registry. Each agent posts a 60 POA lotus bond to join; each epoch a beacon draws five auditors to re-check one job. An auditor who approves a fake loses its own bond, and a failed audit slashes the cheater's bond and uproots it from the trusted garden. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 POA, forfeitable at the first audit; one honest agent pays a single bond, earns audit fees, and keeps all rewards.
